claims.statement: Mitchell issued a challenge to meet Slade, Sullivan, Jem Mace, Joe Goss or Tom Allen for $5,000 to $10,000 a side; the men named did not reply.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen for $5,000 to $10,000 a side.

notes: Gossip from an unnamed old pugilist; Allen is mentioned only in passing. The hint's 1882 date for the benefit is not in the text, so it is left blank.
